goal: Run precommitted rule trace -> automatic first candidate selection -> independent rule suppression -> post-hoc wrong-result scoring with no manual intervention
source: Previous traces run 39105801639 and intervention run 39106010915 are already in-sample; same cases used only for automation engineering
selector: Pick first triage event with risk_signatures sorted by existing ranking score/earliest event, no known-issue/rule-name allowlist and no expected results; output absent -> UNKNOWN
intervention: Run all three baseline SQLConf exclusion and disposable forced skip on the selected rule for each case; count only valid plan changes and restoration of independently frozen expected results as causal evidence
negative_controls: Three N-cases must show no false accusation (a mere rule transition is not a bug); if any changes to wrong output record failure
metrics: actual candidate rule forced skip count
proof that no manually specified rule names enter runtime selector
limits: All six historical SQL statements known in advance: in-sample; no novel bug claimed
Rule ablation alone does not prove exact rewrite subexpression is unsound
No correctness guarantee for arbitrary Spark SQL or all Catalyst rules
expected: Should recover prior 3/3 historical bug restorations without manual candidate names, but first trace may label safe control rewrites too, so distinguish suspicion vs certified wrong output.
